Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENxufs5TvVkNEXNokN5

* Dispatch: pre-filled packing list from one rule; Confirm & print

The packer ticked every box, sleeve, card and carton by hand on every order.
The last 60 PROD packs showed the cost: a customer's own gift/storage box
ticked again (stock taken twice), a customer's storage-box choice shipped in a
gift box, two bars packed with one gift box.

- lib/packing/pack-plan.ts: the rule, written down once. Gift box + bag per
  piece; storage box per 10 pieces when the customer picked one or the order
  has more than 5 (above 5 it replaces the gift boxes); tree sleeve per gift
  box, never with a storage box; outer carton per 2 gift boxes + per storage
  box, one sticker + mailer per carton, none for self-collect; Philosophy card
  + chakra 1 on the buyer's first gold order, chakra N on order N, none from 8.
- Boxes the customer bought count toward the total and are never ticked again.
- products.packing_role / packing_seq (migration 20261127) say which product
  plays which role, so the rule never matches on labels.
- The buyer's gold-order number reuses the dispatch-tile buyer key, which now
  prefers the stored marketplace buyer id (repeat Lazada / TikTok buyers get
  the next chakra card, not Root again).
- Panel: one "Packing list" with the reason on each line; the rest of the
  catalogue is collapsed under "Add something else". Confirm Packing becomes
  "Confirm & print"; the slip button reads "Reprint (updated)" only when the
  pack changed after a print. The slip opens on A4 (one laser tray).

Replay against the last 60 PROD packs: 40 exact; the rest are the known
packing mistakes plus repeat marketplace buyers now numbered correctly.

* Order documents: one PDF (receipt, packing list, every CoA) and one Print button

Mukesh 2026-11-27: "it's just one print button and that prints the receipt,
packing slip and all the COAs as a single print". It was three separate prints.

- lib/documents/order-documents.tsx: loadOrderDocuments + renderOrderDocumentsPdf
  build ONE A4 PDF — the receipt (lib/receipt/load-receipt-data, the receipt
  route's own assembly), a PACKING LIST (contents only: gold with each card's
  serial + bar no., accessories; supplies never listed), and one Certificate of
  Authenticity per card (lookupSerial + coaQr, same rows as /verify; the gift
  block only while a gift is outstanding). Bar photos are WebP, which react-pdf
  drops silently — converted to JPEG on the way in.
- GET /api/admin/orders/[id]/documents-pdf (admin, print theme, no-store).
- Dispatch: one "Print documents" button; "Confirm & print" opens the bundle
  as soon as the pack is saved (the tab opens inside the click, so it is not
  blocked as a pop-up).
- lib/receipt/load-receipt-data.ts: the receipt route's data assembly moved
  out verbatim so the bundle reuses it; the route keeps its auth + cache.
  Source guards now point at the helper.

The same file is what the customer will receive digitally on delivery (next PR).

* Send the order documents to the customer when the order is delivered

Mukesh 2026-11-27: "as soon as our order becomes delivered we should send the pdf
of all the documents as a single file to the customer" — WhatsApp and email,
with a profile setting that defaults to yes.

- Cron /api/cron/order-documents (every 15 min): every order whose lifecycle
  turned 'completed' (the DB stamps lifecycle_completed_at whichever of the
  ~dozen delivery paths did it) since 27 Nov 04:00 UTC and within 3 days gets
  the documents PDF (receipt, packing list, every CoA — #963's bundle, screen
  theme). Vault gold and unclaimed marketplace orders (house customers) are
  closed without a send. Each order is CLAIMED before sending (attempts +1 at
  the count read), so overlapping runs never double-send; 3 failed tries →
  gave_up. Migration 20261127b: orders.documents_sent_at / _outcome / _attempts.
- notifyOrderDocuments: WhatsApp media template (full-URL {{2}}, one template
  for PROD + DEV) + email with the PDF attached. Category "order_documents" is
  DEFAULT-ON. Until Meta approves the template (TEMPLATE_ORDER_DOCUMENTS_PDF
  null) it goes by email only; a WhatsApp-only customer stays due ("no_template"
  is not-attempted, not failed).
- GET /api/orders/documents-pdf/[id](.pdf)?t= — HMAC token for resource
  "order_documents" bound to the order + its customer (or admin); ownership
  checked before rendering; DEV-gate exempt like receipt-pdf.
- Account → Notifications: new "Order documents" row (web card, prefs API,
  overview API, and the server-driven iOS preferences spec — same categoryRow /
  toggle_chip nodes, so installed apps show it with no build).
- scripts/submit-order-documents-pdf-template.mjs (run via "Twilio template ops").

* MAG own-bar / group-pool requests: quote → accept in-app → confirm → automatic set-up

docs/mag-quote-automation-design.md (rev 3). Mukesh 2026-11-27.

- Quote pre-fill: the cheapest bar of the asked size from BullionKing (ranked on
  BullionKing's landed cost, stock shown), suggested % = outright % + cost of
  capital (Admin → MAG setting, 7 % a year; grams bought evenly → ½), rounded up
  to 0.05 %, for 2 weeks / 1 / 2 / 3 / 6 months side by side, with the margin left.
- Durations: 2 weeks, 1, 2, 3, 6 months — 6 is the maximum (requests, quotes and
  the pool-offer table; DB checks).
- Stages on mag_pool_requests (open → quoted → accepted → confirmed →
  [awaiting_bar] → live; declined / expired / withdrawn), kept in step with
  status by a DB check. Every move is guarded on the stage it read.
- Customer: WhatsApp (templates to submit) + email with the quote; "Your MAG
  requests" card in My Account (web) and on the app Dashboard (server-driven,
  §262, no build) with Accept per duration / Decline.
- Admin: Send quote / Resend / Re-quote / Withdraw / Confirm set-up / Set up now.
- Set-up (one tap after accept): bar type at the accepted %, FIFO bar with its
  CoA serial listed reserved / group with closing date = today + duration, member
  added, customer told. No bar in stock → ONE BullionKing purchase order; the
  receipt hook (that PO's bar first) and the hourly mag-request-lifecycle cron
  finish set-up on arrival. Idempotent and resumable.
- A purchase order, not a sale-style consignment obligation: an obligation is a
  sale's COGS (and only accepts an order line / conversion as its source); a MAG
  bar's cost is booked gram by gram from the listing.
- Hourly cron: one reminder 2 days before a quote expires; expiry at 7 days.

Migration 20261127d (applied on DEV).

* MAG reserved bars: buying schedule, daily check, release, one-bar limit — built switched OFF (Agreement §1B)

Mukesh 2026-11-27 (docs/mag-reserved-bar-rhythm-design.md). Every reserved / group bar
gets a buying schedule fixed when it opens; a daily cron checks it (reminders, missed
checkpoints, 7-day catch-up, 2 strikes, release). Release opens the bar at an open-bar
premium (an open type of the same refinery/weight/fineness, else the 2-week quote
premium of the day), moves the grams under §4A when an open bar has room, and returns
the physical bar to stock.

Switched OFF (mag_settings.reserved_rhythm_enabled): everything is a dry run logged
for Admin → MAG → Reserved-bar schedules; no customer-visible change. Enforcement needs
the switch AND the customer's consent on Accept; the 3 live bars are legacy (display
only). The switch refuses to turn on until the published Agreement has Section 1B.

premium of the day), moves the grams under §4A when an open bar has room, and returns
the physical bar to stock.

Switched OFF (mag_settings.reserved_rhythm_enabled): everything is a dry run logged
for Admin → MAG → Reserved-bar schedules; no customer-visible change. Enforcement needs
the switch AND the customer's consent on Accept; the 3 live bars are legacy (display
only). The switch refuses to turn on until the published Agreement has Section 1B.
When on: schedule on the quote (web, app §262 Q16, email), Accept = consent, one live
reserved individual bar per customer, 6-month pause after two schedule releases, shop
card text (§5A), schedule-worded quote/bar-open messages.
